preflight.text: Record the complete current profile settings without exporting unsupported non-VPN formats.

preflight.command:
printf '%s
' '# MDCR_NMCLI_PREFLIGHT' 'set -eu' 'umask 077' state_root=/var/lib/md-code-red 'txn=$state_root/nmcli-static-ipv4.txn' '[ ! -L "$state_root" ] || { printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'Refusing: NetworkManager state root is not root-owned mode 0700'"'"' >&2; exit 1; }' 'install -d -m 0700 -o 0 -g 0 -- "$state_root"' '[ -d "$state_root" ] && [ ! -L "$state_root" ] && [ "$(stat -c '"'"'%u:%a'"'"' -- "$state_root")" = "0:700" ] || { printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'Refusing: NetworkManager state root is not root-owned mode 0700'"'"' >&2; exit 1; }' 'if [ -e "$txn" ] || [ -L "$txn" ]; then' '  printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'Refusing: an unfinished NetworkManager transaction exists'"'"' >&2' '  exit 1' fi 'con=$1' 'record=$(nmcli -g FILENAME,NAME,UUID connection show | awk -F: -v n="$con" '"'"'("x" $2) == ("x" n) || ("x" $3) == ("x" n) { count++; value=$1 } END { if (count == 1) print value; else exit 1 }'"'"') || { printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'Refusing: connection name or UUID did not resolve exactly once'"'"' >&2; exit 1; }' '[ -n "$record" ] && [ -f "$record" ] && [ ! -L "$record" ] || { printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'Refusing: expected one regular NetworkManager profile file'"'"' >&2; exit 1; }' 'profile_file=$record' 'mkdir -m 0700 -- "$txn"' 'cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$txn"; }' 'trap cleanup EXIT' 'trap '"'"'exit 1'"'"' HUP INT TERM' '[ -d "$txn" ] && [ ! -L "$txn" ] && [ "$(stat -c '"'"'%u:%a'"'"' -- "$txn")" = "0:700" ] || { printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'Refusing: no trusted complete NetworkManager transaction'"'"' >&2; exit 1; }' 'cp -a -- "$profile_file" "$txn/before"' 'printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' "$profile_file" > "$txn/profile_path"' '[ -f "$txn/before" ] && [ ! -L "$txn/before" ] && [ "$(stat -c '"'"'%u'"'"' -- "$txn/before")" = "0" ] || { printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'Refusing: no trusted complete NetworkManager transaction'"'"' >&2; exit 1; }' '[ -f "$txn/profile_path" ] && [ ! -L "$txn/profile_path" ] && [ "$(stat -c '"'"'%u'"'"' -- "$txn/profile_path")" = "0" ] || { printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'Refusing: no trusted complete NetworkManager transaction'"'"' >&2; exit 1; }' 'trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM' | sudo sh -s -- <con>
preflight.text: Resolve exactly one name or UUID through the RHEL-documented FILENAME,NAME,UUID listing, then preserve the actual profile in an atomically created transaction beneath the root-owned, mode-0700 /var/lib/md-code-red state directory.
